_doc: Golden adversarial bank (design section 10.1, T-3). One entry per tests/candidates/<name>.py.
tests/test_evaluator.py runs evaluator.evaluate on each file and asserts the bands below.
Reward version is detected from the metrics keys: 'lean_ladder' present => v2 (design 5.3/5.4:
verified floor 0.20, unverified cap 0.19); otherwise the legacy v1 evaluator (E6/E8 reward with
the proved-library floor), for which only structural checks (lean_ok, sound_battery, score
Check vocabulary -- v2: ladder (int or list of ints), score ([lo, hi] inclusive), lean_ok (float,
'le_initial' | [lo, hi]). 'sound_battery' is asserted under both versions.
'requires': files (relative to upper_bounds/) that must exist, else the test is skipped.
'slow': the test waits for the gate timeout; skipped when ZAR_UB_GOLDEN_SKIP_SLOW=1.
E27 (2026-09-23): reward v3 / suite v3. The 'v2' key of an expectation still means 'the verified-floor reward family' (lean_ladder present); bands are for reward v3 on the default suite v3.

initial.why: the proved library verbatim: verified, kills nothing beyond B

unsound_row7.why: Python kill fires on a witnessed case: battery. Since 2026-09-22 (E19) a wrong MIRROR no longer zeroes a verified Lean prune: the Lean kill (= library) is L5 and kills nothing new -> 0.20 with sound_battery 0, agreement < 1, mirror_unsound artifact. E28: an unsound mirror on an L5 candidate costs MIRROR_PENALTY=0.02, so the no-op-Lean version scores 0.18.

artifact_contains.mirror_unsound: only the Lean kill earns credit

sorry_in_kill.why: sorry outside a have-hole in sound: forbidden

sorry_in_sound.why: one typed hole the auto-fill list cannot close

axiom_smuggle.why: real axiom hidden from a comment-stripping scanner by /- and -/ inside strings

slow_kill.why: 2^(m+n+4)-step kill: the #eval mask never arrives within the 480 s gate timeout (240 s before E27). Design §4.2 L1 'kill too slow': the gate re-runs the elaboration alone after a timeout (Lean buffers stdout, so nothing survives the SIGKILL) and attributes the timeout to the mask evaluation. Score <= 0.19 (unverified band).

instance_specific.why: candidate : Prune target type-checks on the first instance only

cond_deletion.why: CondPrune target [z(9,8;3,3)=45 tan2022] beside the library candidate (Cond.lean interface)

notDescending.why: symmetry break as a prune: sound fails (omega)

cond_candidateF.why: candidateF : CondPrune target [tan2022 fact] through the gate's conditional entry point; no fact granted on the pure TRAIN table -> never -> floor

schema_farkas.why: initial program + 8 TRAIN Farkas certificates in SCHEMA_DATA (E-schemas): Prune.ofFarkas is library-proved, so found parameters earn verified credit. v2: 0.2496 (schema_gain = proven_gain = 0.137). v3 (E27): 0.2014 -- the 8 certificates kill mostly EASY square-cell cases (<= 20k conflicts), which v3 no longer pays for (R3 attacks A/B).

lean_dgh4.why: hand-proved DGH (F-dgh4) inlined + candidate := ofList [counting, argDGH]. Under reward/suite v3 (E27) the wide exact TRAIN cells make DGH count: it closes (11,21,117)p (lower-bound work >= 1.4e7 conflicts -> Depth and Close) and kills part of (9,16), (9,18), (10,23). Under v2 it scored exactly 0.20 on the default suite.

python_only_dgh4.why: DGH in the Python mirror only (Lean = library): no verified credit; agreement < 1 only on a DGH-attackable target

schema_recipe.why: search-mode candidate: SCHEMA_DATA computed at import by zar_ub.lemmas.search_certificates (E20); verified credit through Prune.ofFarkas, no new proof v2: 0.2594; v3 (E27): 0.2497 live (search budget is wall-time dependent), 0.2430 for the frozen twin.

e1_dgh_s2.why: E25 exploit e1 (R1): argDGH only when s = 2 -> clears the tiny GEN table (8,9;2,2) w=27 (1 survivor, 150 conflicts). v2/S1 paid 0.2400; v3 pays nothing because no GEN case has work above 20k conflicts.

e2_easy_certs.why: E25 exploit e2 (R1): Farkas certificates that kill only easy cases (d <= table median), broadly. v2 paid 0.2068; v3 pays ~0 (easy work is below the 20k excess threshold).

e3_relist.why: E25 exploit e3 (R1): re-lists every library prune: kills nothing new -> exactly the floor.

cert_close_10_22.why: E25/R3 finding 1: one certificate closing the small tan2022 target (10,22,111) (3 survivors, 58,333 conflicts of true work). VR paid 0.3087 on an inflated censored label; v3 computes closure importance from lower-bound work (< 1e6 -> no Close/Depth) and pays only its small hard-work target gain.
